'''2010 Canadian Nationals Stephen Kim DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kim]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Damp Toes
* '''Username:''' vaith
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
